n = int(input())
line = input()

processed_line = []
words_in_parentheses = 0
index = 0

while index < len(line):
    if line[index] == '(':
        processed_line.append('_')
        index += 1
        inside_parentheses = []
        while line[index] != ')':
            inside_parentheses.append(line[index])
            index += 1
        words = ''.join(inside_parentheses).split('_')
        for word in words:
            if word:
                words_in_parentheses += 1
    else:
        processed_line.append(line[index])
    index += 1

parts = ''.join(processed_line).split('_')
max_word_length = 0
for part in parts:
    if part and len(part) > max_word_length:
        max_word_length = len(part)

print(f"{max_word_length} {words_in_parentheses}")
